reviewer.role: Independent read-only source and deterministic-test reviewer

verification.execution: Independently rerun by this reviewer; ordinary real CLI test execution, no model calls.

findings: No immediate blocker found in the draft source and its bounded structural-inspection design.

Author inspection consumes exact persisted output text after write_output; Validate inspection consumes supplied source.skill before the report. Duplicate, missing, unexpected, byte-mismatched and incorrectly ordered inspections fail.

The isolated foreign occupant uses canonical .faff/config.yaml and an explicit empty .faff/config.local.yaml overlay. The subprocess uses an empty environment, read-only Node file permissions and no child-process permission.

The grader requires foreign membership exit 1, expected configured lint exit, exactly one configured occupant in RESULT, no signal/error/stderr and unchanged input bytes. This avoids missing-occupant and command-failure false passes.
The public task projects only case identity, mode, slot, task and source; private oracle fields are not projected. Full policy delivery is guarded before operations.
Current tests establish structural port and capture checks only; the semantic distinction test is a rubric rejection, not a completed semantic authoring fixture.
mandatory_before_qualification: Freeze and bind the exact fixture, both complete policy/context arms, runtime commit/source and full imported helper closure. The wrapper manifest alone binds only its own source and is insufficient as import-closure qualification.

Freshly rerun real inspections from actual persisted Author artifacts and exact Validate source skills under the pinned runtime. Bind artifact/capture hashes and compare semantic consumer results; temporary-directory relocation must not hide other changes. Do not rely solely on captured stdout or a recomputed grade over captured inspection results.

Independently manually review every actual artifact against all applicable semantic checklist obligations, supplied facts and seeded violations, rejecting invented violations and invented requirements. Structural lint success is not semantic conformance.

For the native review wrapper Author case, consume its explicit native-result conversion example with the real pinned review-verdict contract consumer, including a meaningful invalid mutation. Claim example admission only, not execution of the generated wrapper.
Review and freeze the final fixture and public task for oracle leakage, inherited ambiguities, mandatory reference delivery and bounded scope before any model measurement.
Retain separate native policy-delivery/identity gates, actual artifact bindings and completed-case checks; no candidate or source acceptance follows from this draft review.

additional_negative_preflight: warning-only or skipped consumer false pass

known_inherited_ambiguities_and_limits: Rendering has an explicit refer-back exemption despite generic statements elsewhere; do not turn generic wording into a hidden rendering failure.
Intake lacks a fixed contract despite generic producer-emission wording.
The unchanged scaffold does not mandate one exact heading arrangement.
The fixed slot table predates some current slots; gateway authority governs without silently expanding this cut.

Current configured lint skips registered occupants without verifying slot compatibility, whereas is-bundled checks compatibility. Preserve this consumer limitation; do not require a configured failure that the consumer does not implement.
Configured profile checks are not complete charter or seam-registry checks. Where structural requirements rely on referenced material, deliver that reference context identically to both arms.
SKILL.md source is not ordinary human-facing rendered prose; do not apply unrelated rendering density or visual-form requirements to authored source.
This review does not prove live installation, runtime adoption, generated-skill execution, full authoring-policy equivalence or model parity.
No final fixture exists in this review scope; the proposed matrix is a recommendation and requires its own review and zero-model preflight.
writes: Only this independent review record; no source, helper, fixture or active-run edits.
